name: Can I replace mobile home batten strips with standard wood trim?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace mobile home batten strips with standard wood trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing factory batten strips with real wood molding creates a polished look, but it requires addressing standard mobile home wall construction. Factory mobile home walls often use vinyl-coated gypsum panels with plastic or pressed-paper battens covering the seams. Upgrading to real wood baseboards, casing, or crown molding requires securing trim into lightweight 2x3 framing studs or using specialized adhesives and finishing nails. HH Remodeling specializes in finish carpentry, allowing homeowners to replace dated plastic strips with properly fitted wood trim, seamless drywall repairs, and professional interior painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it requires careful fastening into lightweight 2x3 wall studs or drywall patching where previous factory strips covered panel seams.
